d.title: One Piece: Densetsu no Log! Akagami no Shanks!
d.en: One Piece: The Captain's Log of the Legend! Red-Haired Shanks!
d.jp: 伝説の記録！赤髪のシャンクス！
d.synopsis: As the world anticipates the legendary diva Uta’s show in Elegia, the Red-Hair Pirates are making some disturbing moves. Koby remembers how Shanks ended the Paramount War at Marineford.
